sourceText: User requested a new story to review the large Proof-or-Stop agent prompt consolidation execution plan document, perform 3x2 review against the current project situation, and after DONE provide a complete table of concrete optimizations with reasons and evidence.
normalizedOutcome: The target execution-plan markdown is reviewed through evidence-backed 3x2, approved optimizations are applied, and the DONE response/table lists each concrete optimization with reason and project evidence.
acceptanceClaim: B-2861 is acceptable when the target document and final response include an evidence-backed optimization table, and checklist evidence shows the 3x2 review, reconciliation ledger, and document optimizations were completed without code-scope expansion.
